agyos_skill.intent: Choose or optimize a vector store and embedding workflow for RAG, semantic search, or recommendations. Use for indexing, chunking, recall, latency, and scale decisions.
agyos_skill.instructions: Choose or optimize a vector store and embedding workflow for RAG, semantic search, or recommendations. Use for indexing, chunking, recall, latency, and scale decisions. - The task is unrelated to vector database engineer - You need a different domain or tool outside this scope - Clarify goals, constraints, and required inputs. - Apply relevant best practices and validate outcomes. - Provide actionable steps and verification. - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`. - Vector database selection and architecture - Embedding model selection and optimization - Index configuration (HNSW, IVF, PQ) - Hybrid search (vector + keyword) implementation - Chunking strategies for documents - Metadata filtering and pre/post-filtering - Performance tuning and scaling - Building RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems - Implementing semantic search over documents - Creating recommendation engines - Building image/audio similarity search - Optimizing vector search latency and recall - Scaling vector operations to millions of vectors 1. Analyze data characteristics and query patterns 2. Select appropriate embedding model 3. Design chunking and preprocessing pipeline 4. Choose vector database and index type 5. Configure metadata schema for filtering
